description: Unscope every control mapped only to these frameworks (destructive write — editor). Shared controls are kept. An MCR framework, or one taking out a material control, needs an admin and a reason.

removal_reason.description: Why these controls leave scope — recorded in the audit trail. Required (400 without it), with an admin key (403 otherwise), when a framework carries an MCR obligation or its removal would take a material control out of scope
